subject: Initial intro: Redwood demo + discovery — coordinating stakeholders
thread_body:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.gg>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@fastlyte.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fastlyte.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.gg>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.gg>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial intro: Redwood demo + discovery — coordinating stakeholders

Alex / Priya —

Thanks for taking the time to chat last week. Per our conversation, the goal for an initial call is:
- 20–30 minute discovery to align on primary use case and success criteria (champion + eng lead)
- 20–30 minute demo focused on infra/ops + integration approach (AE + SE + eng lead)

To make scheduling straightforward, here are a few windows (PDT):
- Tue Oct 20: 11:00–11:45 OR 14:00–14:45
- Wed Oct 21: 09:00–09:45 OR 15:00–15:45

Ask: can you confirm which slot works best for the champion (Alex) and engineering lead (Priya)? I will add Soojin (SE) and Dev (solutions) once you confirm — we can compress to a single 45-min slot if that’s preferred.

I’m attaching a short agenda + a security checklist folks usually request so procurement/security can triage ahead of time.

[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf]
[Attachment: security-checklist.xlsx]

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FAST-2026-0911
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-demo-pack

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.gg | +1 (415) 555-0123

----

From: Alex Morris <alex.morris@fastlyte.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.gg>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fastlyte.com>, procurement@fastlyte.com, Tom Henderson <tom.h@fastlyte.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 17:12:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial intro: Redwood demo + discovery — coordinating stakeholders

Karthik —

Thanks, these windows look good. Priya and I are available for Tue Oct 20 11:00–11:45 PDT. Procurement (cc’d) also wants to see the agenda and a high-level pricing/commitment summary before the meeting — they may not join the first call but want context.

Tom (security) is also cc’d — he’ll flag any show-stoppers on the checklist you attached. If you can send a calendar invite with a short agenda and any pre-reads, we’ll confirm on our side.

Thanks,
Alex Morris
Head of Product — Fastlyte
alex.morris@fastlyte.com

----

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fastlyte.com>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@fastlyte.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.gg>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 20:05:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial intro: Redwood demo + discovery — coordinating stakeholders

11:00 on Tuesday works for me. If we can keep it tight to 30–45 minutes that’d be ideal — we want to cover integration touchpoints (auth, VPC, data flow) briefly.

Cheers,
Priya
Engineering Lead — Fastlyte

----

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.gg>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.gg>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.gg>
Cc: Alex Morris <alex.morris@fastlyte.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fastlyte.com>, procurement@fastlyte.com, Tom Henderson <tom.h@fastlyte.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:10:15 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Initial intro: Redwood demo + discovery — coordinating stakeholders

Soojin / Dev —

Alex and Priya confirmed Tue Oct 20 at 11:00–11:45 PDT. Can you both join? Main asks for the call:
- Quick discovery (champion + eng lead): scope, traffic profile, compliance constraints
- 20-min demo: deployment options (hosted vs private), latency/cost tradeoffs, one integration example
- Procurement/security: high-level licensing and evidence items (attached)

Prep notes for SE: if you can have a single slide on our routing/fallback + an example of autoscaling/dedicated pools that would be perfect.

If we need to shorten to 30m let me know and I’ll adjust slides.

-Karthik

----

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.gg>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.gg>, Alex Morris <alex.morris@fastlyte.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fastlyte.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.gg>, procurement@fastlyte.com, Tom Henderson <tom.h@fastlyte.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:22:48 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial intro: Redwood demo + discovery — coordinating stakeholders

Thanks Karthik — I’m on for Tue 11:00 PDT. I’ll cover routing/fallback and a short demo showing a hosted vs private deployment flow.

Quick asks for the Fastlyte team if possible before the call:
- Typical QPS / peak concurrency for the use case (ballpark is fine)
- Any strict data residency or retention requirements
- Who owns infra (SL or SRE) so we can direct technical follow-ups

Also attaching a short evidence bundle we typically share with security teams.

[Attachment: evidence-request.docx]
[Attachment: SOC2-sample.txt]

See you Tuesday — I’ll plan for 40 minutes and keep 10 for Q&A.

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.gg | +1 (415) 555-0199

Perfect — we’ll take Tue 11:00–11:45 PDT. I’ve asked procurement to keep the invite on their calendar as tentatively accepted. Tom will review the security bundle ahead of the call.

Please send the calendar invite + dial-in and I’ll circulate internally.

Thanks,
Alex
